sigye.label: Sigye — Terminal Clock
sigye.description: A feature-rich terminal clock with ASCII art fonts, animated backgrounds, and productivity timers. 6 display modes including Clock, Pomodoro, Timer, Stopwatch, World Clock, and Countdown. 40+ bundled FIGlet fonts, 18 color themes, 21 animated backgrounds, and desktop notifications.
sigye.author: am2rican5

chess-tui.label: Chess TUI
chess-tui.description: A free, open-source terminal chess game. Play with a friend locally, against any UCI chess engine (e.g. Stockfish), or online via Lichess. Features local 2-player mode, engine integration, Lichess multiplayer, helper menu, and custom skins. Runs on macOS, Linux, and Windows.
chess-tui.author: thomas-mauran
